feed.headline: Issued a reminder on 13th November 2026 to shareholders holding physical shares to dematerialize them.
feed.subject: Trent Limited has informed the Exchange about Reminder letter to  shareholders to Dematerialise the Shares
feed.summary: Trent Limited issued a reminder on 13th November 2026 to shareholders holding physical shares to dematerialize them. The company cites SEBI regulations prohibiting the transfer of physical shares since April 1, 2021, and the issuance of new physical certificates since January 2022. Shareholders are urged to contact their Depository Participant to convert physical holdings into demat form. The letter outlines benefits including convenient holding, immediate transfer, reduced paperwork, and direct credit for corporate actions. The Registrar and Share Transfer Agent is MUFG Intime India Private Limited. Queries can be directed to them at Mumbai. The intimation is also placed on the company website.

feed.summary: Trent Limited has intimated the schedule of meetings with analysts and institutional investors pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Wasatch Global Advisors and Kotak Mahindra Asset Management Singapore are scheduled for one-to-one meetings on 17th November 2026. CEO Track JM Financial will participate in the 17th Annual Flagship Conference India Xchange 2026 on 18th November 2026. RBC Global Asset Management Asia is scheduled for a one-to-one meeting on 24th November 2026. T. Rowe Price Aayush Kumar will hold a one-to-one meeting on 25th November 2026. JP Morgan Asset Management is scheduled for a one-to-one meeting on 26th November 2026. The schedule is subject to change. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during these meetings.
